fit.scope: Numerical real-arithmetic minimum over arbitrary global rank-at-most-K linear innovation output spaces for this already-known all-C observed future matrix and fixed current-C anchor. This oracle learns directions separately from each split's future labels; it is unavailable at deployment, excludes FP32 rounding and nonlinear/readout alternatives, and does not prove past input-information sufficiency or generalization. MAE/physical scores are values of the normalized-MSE minimizer, not separate minima.
